record.original_question: Let E := Lp (Ω, µ) for 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞ and a σ-finite measure space (Ω, µ) and let (Tt )t∈[0,∞) ⊆ L(E) be a strongly continuous semigroup on E such that Tt is a positive kernel operators for each t > 0, meaning that there exists a measurable function kt : Ω × Ω → R+ such that Z (Tt f )(y) = kt (y, x)f (x)dµ(x) Ω for almost every y ∈ Ω. Assume that (Tt )t∈[0,∞) is mean ergodic, meaning that the limit 1 T Z lim Tt f dt T →∞ T 0 exists in E for all f ∈ E. Does it follow that (Tt ) is strongly convergent, i.e. limt→∞ Tt f exists for all f ∈ E?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a $\sigma$-finite measure space, let $1 \le p \le \infty$, and set $E := L^p(\Omega,\mu)$. Let $(T_t)_{t\in[0,\infty)} \subseteq \mathcal{L}(E)$ be a strongly continuous semigroup of bounded linear operators on $E$ with the property that for each $t > 0$ the operator $T_t$ is a positive kernel operator: there exists a measurable function $k_t : \Omega \times \Omega \to [0,\infty)$ such that
$$ (T_t f)(y) = \int_\Omega k_t(y,x) f(x)\, d\mu(x) \quad \text{for } \mu\text{-a.e. } y \in \Omega, $$
for every $f \in E$. Assume that $(T_t)$ is mean ergodic, i.e. for every $f \in E$ the Cesàro limit
$$ \lim_{T\to\infty} \frac{1}{T}\int_0^T T_t f\, dt $$
exists in $E$. Does it follow that $(T_t)$ is strongly convergent, that is, does $\lim_{t\to\infty} T_t f$ exist in $E$ for every $f \in E$?
artifact.status_search_result: Related Tauberian theorems are known: semigroups of kernel operators with non-trivial fixed space converge strongly to their mean ergodic projection, and weakly ergodic eventually strong Feller semigroups converge strongly. However, the general question of whether mere mean ergodicity of a strongly continuous semigroup of positive kernel operators on $L^p$ implies strong convergence does not appear to have been resolved in the searched literature, and is posed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: A Tauberian theorem for strong Feller semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: A weakly ergodic, eventually strong Feller semigroup on the space of measures on a Polish space converges strongly to a projection onto its fixed space.
status_evidence.claim: Tauberian results are known under additional Feller-type assumptions, but not for the general kernel-operator semigroup case.

status_evidence.title: Semigroups of Kernel Operators (Gerlach)
status_evidence.snippet: Semigroups of kernel operators with a non-trivial fixed space converge strongly to its mean ergodic projection.
status_evidence.claim: Strong convergence is established under additional hypotheses such as non-trivial fixed space.
